scope: Primary experimental sources, preliminary NACA0012 comparison, accurate popular-science method description

new_runs.method: Existing uniform D3Q27 cumulant CPU solver; no numerical model changes
new_runs.geometry: NACA0012 analytic finite trailing-edge definition, 81 points per side, one element, no flap

experimental_data.low_re: Ohtake, Nakae, Motohashi 2007; Re=30000, Cl Fig.5, Cd Fig.6, Cm(c/4) Fig.11; digitize distinguishable triangular markers
experimental_data.high_re: NASA Ladson TM-4074 table IX, Re=5.95e6, M=0.15, 80-W trip; retain original values and conditions
experimental_data.interpolation: Piecewise linear within each measured coefficient series, preserving original digitized angles

digitization_policy: Calibrate from PDF frame, separate legend markers, visually inspect overlays, record half-marker-size bounds; do not call them tunnel uncertainty
analysis: Signed absolute differences Cl/Cd/Cm; Cd relative difference for nonzero experimental Cd
Same alpha/Re and moment convention; document geometry, turbulence/transition, span/tunnel and Mach mismatches/unknowns
Report actual averaging times, counts, RMS and block/half-window changes; do not equate RMS with uncertainty of mean
Compare the two mesh results as grid sensitivity only; no formal observed order or GCI from two meshes
Do not alter physical inputs or averaging interval to fit experimental data
Report time-limit or numerical failures as incomplete; preserve checkpoints and partial histories
No physical validation pass/fail threshold claimed: missing numerical/statistical convergence and unknown tunnel uncertainty keep validation inconclusive
high_re_solver_comparison: not_run: released Flow rejects Re=6e6; no fabricated calculation or extrapolation from low Re
method_text: Separate UTF-8 TXT explaining actual 0.5 implementation, not a proposed high-Re solver; cite primary method papers and exact source/pinned dependencies
